achievements.name: Small Blind
achievements.detail: Score the chips a small blind asks for and cash out the round.

achievements.name: Boss Blind
achievements.detail: Clear an ante's boss blind while its special rule is active.

achievements.name: Shop Purchase
achievements.detail: Buy a joker, playing card, or voucher from the shop between blinds.

achievements.name: Flush
achievements.detail: Play five cards of the same suit so the hand scores as a flush.

achievements.name: Ante Eight
achievements.detail: Defeat the boss of ante eight and complete a standard run.

achievements.name: New Deck
achievements.detail: Unlock another deck and begin a run on something other than the red deck.

achievements.name: Red Stake
achievements.detail: Win a run while the stake is set to red.

achievements.name: Million Chips
achievements.detail: Score one million chips or more with a single hand.

achievements.name: Five of a Kind
achievements.detail: Alter the deck until five cards share a rank, then play them as one hand.

achievements.name: Challenge
achievements.detail: Clear any challenge from the challenge list under its fixed rules.

achievements.name: Gold Stake
achievements.detail: Win a run with the stake set all the way to gold.

achievements.name: Legendary Joker
achievements.detail: Take a legendary joker when the Soul card offers one in a pack.
